name: Hip 156
sale: Grovendale Sales, agent for William B. Harrigan
notes: Sister to G3 winner Seek and Destroy on the immediate family; 2nd dam Search and Seizure unraced but dam of 7 winners across 3 generations of black type (Tammy the Torpedo, Seek and Destroy, High Opinion). Flameaway (Scat Daddy) is a leading third-crop sire (Bear River G2, Dark Saffron 2x G1), 2026 fee $10,000. Bought at $130,000 — well above his ~$16-24K recent yearling average, so this was a full/competitive price rather than a value catch.
